_meta.description: Enforcement action tracking index for BIS, DOJ-NSD, and OFAC export control and sanctions cases
_meta.sources: BIS charging letters (bis.gov/enforcement); DOJ-NSD press releases (justice.gov/nsd); OFAC enforcement releases (ofac.treasury.gov)

_schema.respondent: Entity or individual name as published
_schema.date: ISO 8601 date of charging letter / indictment / settlement
_schema.controlled_items: ECCN or description of controlled items
_schema.charges: Array of 15 CFR § 764.2 provisions or criminal statutes
_schema.resolution: charging-letter | civil-penalty | plea | tdo | denial-order | compliance-order
_schema.penalty_usd: Civil penalty amount in USD (null if not applicable)
_schema.notes: Free-text notes on significant legal issues
